name: Lean 4 Web IDE with Interactive Domain Widgets and In-Context Scoped Variation Generator
description: Interactive browser-based Lean 4 Web IDE hosted on GitHub Pages featuring domain-agnostic interactive widgets (3D WebGL SDF raymarching, WebAudio live spectrogram, generalized hyperdimensional function plotter) and an in-context scoped PCFG/PHOG variation generator with a live visual gallery.
